page.notes: The woodcut initial H is set in a decorative frame. The first Greek line and the Greek word in the Caput III paragraph are printed in Greek; some Greek is uncertain and may contain errors. The word "Inte-" at the foot is a catchword-like hyphenated start of the next page. The right page shows only fragments of the neighbouring column (ter, ex, ue, to, en, cu, lie, pro, tur, enu, tum, finer, nulli, milli, riod, quen, dis, rum, nem, stror, dum, quat, ginta), which are not transcribed.
